_comment: Copy this file to camel-gate.local.json in the same directory and fill in the placeholders. That path is git-ignored: it is the only place a machine-specific value belongs. Keys you leave out keep the defaults in camel-gate-config.ps1; a key that begins with '_' is a comment and is ignored.
sshHost: <the ssh alias or host name the gate connects to>
sshExe: <absolute path of ssh.exe, or leave out to use ssh from PATH>
scpExe: <absolute path of scp.exe, or leave out to use scp from PATH>
stateDir: <absolute path of the directory that holds build-state.json, test-state.json and run-registry.jsonl>
hostLibStdCxxDir: <absolute path, on the host, of the toolchain libstdc++ directory -- only for installs built before they carried their own>
watchRepo: <absolute path of the checkout watch-fsh-dev.ps1 follows>
mergeWorktree: <absolute path of the ONE worktree allowed to push develop -- scripts/hooks/pre-push refuses every other tree; a JSON array or a ';'-separated list when this machine keeps more than one, and leaving the key out means no tree may push develop>
baselineWorktree: <absolute path of the worktree merge-lane.ps1 measures the baseline in -- a tree that is NOT the one being merged, built once and kept warm; it may not exist yet, the merge tool creates it, and leaving the key out means a merge refuses to start>
baselineRoot: <absolute path of the directory the per-tip baseline checkouts live under -- each tree is named by the commit it measures (<baselineRoot>/<sha>), so three seats landing on one tip share one tree and one reading; set this instead of baselineWorktree, which stays as the legacy fixed path>
scratchRoot: <absolute path of the directory merge-batch.ps1 writes its two worktrees and its transcripts in>
